tasks.description: Develop a lightweight model to estimate CO concentration using PT08.S1(CO) sensor readings and compare with CO(GT) ground truth values.

Analyze the relationship between sensor responses (PT08.S1(CO), PT08.S2(NMHC), PT08.S3(NOx), PT08.S4(NO2), PT08.S5(O3)) and environmental conditions (T, RH, AH) to identify potential cross-sensitivities.
Implement a simple drift detection algorithm to identify changes in sensor responses over time, potentially indicating concept drift or sensor degradation.

Compare sensor readings (PT08.S1(CO), PT08.S2(NMHC), PT08.S3(NOx), PT08.S4(NO2), PT08.S5(O3)) with corresponding ground truth values (CO(GT), NMHC(GT), C6H6(GT), NOx(GT), NO2(GT)) to evaluate sensor accuracy.
Investigate how temperature (T) and relative humidity (RH) affect sensor responses, particularly focusing on PT08.S1(CO), PT08.S2(NMHC), PT08.S3(NOx), and PT08.S4(NO2).
Develop a model to estimate Benzene (C6H6) concentration using available sensor readings and compare with C6H6(GT) ground truth values.

tasks.task_name: Identify Daily Patterns in Sensor Readings
tasks.description: Analyze sensor readings (e.g., PT08.S1(CO), PT08.S5(O3)) for daily patterns or cycles, potentially aiding in anomaly detection or sensor calibration.
